			every_active_accolade = { limit = { accolade_attribute_level = { type = manipulator_attribute level >= 3 } } add = { value = scope:ck3xbl_kl.dread multiply = 5 } }

			# other:task_train_commanders:task_boost_knights_modifier (common/council_tasks/00_marshal_tasks.txt:324)
			every_councillor = { limit = { is_performing_council_task = task_train_commanders } add = { value = marshal_knights_overtime_boost_scale divide = 100 multiply = 1000 } }

			every_councillor = { limit = { is_performing_council_task = task_manage_guards } add = { value = marshal_overtime_boost_scale divide = 100 multiply = 1000 } }

			if = { limit = { has_royal_court = yes has_court_type = court_warlike court_grandeur_current_level >= 1 } add = 100 }

			if = { limit = { has_royal_court = yes has_court_type = court_tribal court_grandeur_current_level >= 1 } add = 50 }

			if = { limit = { domicile ?= { is_domicile_type = camp } has_domicile_temperament_high = yes } add = { add = default_temperament_high_value_scale min = 1 if = { limit = { NOT = { has_perk = absolute_control_perk } } multiply = 0 } multiply = 100 } }

			if = { limit = { has_government = japan_feudal_government } add = 100 }

			if = { limit = { has_game_rule = very_hard_difficulty is_ai = no } add = -500 }
		}
	}
	clear_saved_scope = ck3xbl_kl
	clear_saved_scope = holder
	clear_saved_scope = councillor_liege
}

# this = army, right after its A/J dump. Siege role, and whose land the battle barony is, seen from the army owner: own =
# the controller is the owner or below him; hostile = the controller is at war with the owner or with the owner's top
# liege (is_at_war_with ignores lieges' wars); other = anything else (allied, neutral, no controller).
ck3xbl_emit_ax_army_effect = {
	if = { limit = { is_army_in_siege = yes } info_log = "CK3XBL|AX|besieging|yes" }
	else = { info_log = "CK3XBL|AX|besieging|no" }
	army_owner = { save_scope_as = ck3xbl_ax_owner }
	if = { limit = { location = { barony_controller ?= { target_is_same_character_or_above = scope:ck3xbl_ax_owner } } } info_log = "CK3XBL|AX|territory|own" }
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			location = {
				barony_controller ?= {
					OR = {
						is_at_war_with = scope:ck3xbl_ax_owner
						is_at_war_with = scope:ck3xbl_ax_owner.top_liege
					}
				}
			}
		}
		info_log = "CK3XBL|AX|territory|hostile"
	}
	else = { info_log = "CK3XBL|AX|territory|other" }
	clear_saved_scope = ck3xbl_ax_owner
}

		else_if = { limit = { has_trait_xp = { trait = aggressive_attacker value >= 66 } } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|txp|aggressive_attacker|2" }

# this = character, after its combat CX lines: the accolade of an acclaimed knight (CX|acc_*; glory itself is not
# readable in script, the rank bounds it).
ck3xbl_emit_accolade_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_acclaimed = yes }
		save_scope_as = ck3xbl_acc_knight
		accolade = {
			if = {
				limit = { accolade_owner ?= { any_active_accolade = { acclaimed_knight ?= scope:ck3xbl_acc_knight } } }
				info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_active|yes"
			}
			else = { info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_active|no" }
			if = { limit = { accolade_rank >= 6 } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_rank|6" }
			else_if = { limit = { accolade_rank >= 5 } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_rank|5" }
			else_if = { limit = { accolade_rank >= 4 } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_rank|4" }
			else_if = { limit = { accolade_rank >= 3 } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_rank|3" }
			else_if = { limit = { accolade_rank >= 2 } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_rank|2" }
			else_if = { limit = { accolade_rank >= 1 } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_rank|1" }
			else = { info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_rank|0" }
			initial_type ?= {
				if = { limit = { this = accolade_type:marauder_attribute } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_primary|marauder_attribute" }
				else_if = { limit = { this = accolade_type:idealist_attribute } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_primary|idealist_attribute" }
				else_if = { limit = { this = accolade_type:charmer_attribute } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_primary|charmer_attribute" }
				else_if = { limit = { this = accolade_type:thug_attribute } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_primary|thug_attribute" }
				else_if = { limit = { this = accolade_type:disciplinarian_attribute } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_primary|disciplinarian_attribute" }
				else_if = { limit = { this = accolade_type:fanatic_attribute } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_primary|fanatic_attribute" }
				else_if = { limit = { this = accolade_type:valiant_attribute } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_primary|valiant_attribute" }
				else_if = { limit = { this = accolade_type:stalwart_attribute } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_primary|stalwart_attribute" }
				else_if = { limit = { this = accolade_type:scoundrel_attribute } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_primary|scoundrel_attribute" }
				else_if = { limit = { this = accolade_type:huntsmaster_attribute } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_primary|huntsmaster_attribute" }
				else_if = { limit = { this = accolade_type:blademaster_attribute } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_primary|blademaster_attribute" }
				else_if = { limit = { this = accolade_type:master_of_revels_attribute } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_primary|master_of_revels_attribute" }
				else_if = { limit = { this = accolade_type:house_knight_attribute } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_primary|house_knight_attribute" }
				else_if = { limit = { this = accolade_type:archer_attribute } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_primary|archer_attribute" }
				else_if = { limit = { this = accolade_type:skirmisher_attribute } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_primary|skirmisher_attribute" }
				else_if = { limit = { this = accolade_type:pike_attribute } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_primary|pike_attribute" }
				else_if = { limit = { this = accolade_type:outrider_attribute } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_primary|outrider_attribute" }
				else_if = { limit = { this = accolade_type:vanguard_attribute } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_primary|vanguard_attribute" }
				else_if = { limit = { this = accolade_type:lancer_attribute } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_primary|lancer_attribute" }
				else_if = { limit = { this = accolade_type:crossbowmen_attribute } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_primary|crossbowmen_attribute" }
				else_if = { limit = { this = accolade_type:besieger_attribute } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_primary|besieger_attribute" }
				else_if = { limit = { this = accolade_type:camelry_attribute } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_primary|camelry_attribute" }
				else_if = { limit = { this = accolade_type:elephantry_attribute } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_primary|elephantry_attribute" }
				else_if = { limit = { this = accolade_type:horse_archer_attribute } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_primary|horse_archer_attribute" }
				else_if = { limit = { this = accolade_type:gunpowder_attribute } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_primary|gunpowder_attribute" }
				else_if = { limit = { this = accolade_type:politicker_attribute } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_primary|politicker_attribute" }
				else_if = { limit = { this = accolade_type:tactician_attribute } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_primary|tactician_attribute" }
				else_if = { limit = { this = accolade_type:reeve_attribute } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_primary|reeve_attribute" }
				else_if = { limit = { this = accolade_type:manipulator_attribute } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_primary|manipulator_attribute" }
				else_if = { limit = { this = accolade_type:mentor_attribute } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_primary|mentor_attribute" }
				else_if = { limit = { this = accolade_type:contender_attribute } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_primary|contender_attribute" }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_accolade_type = marauder_attribute }

# this = character, after its accolade lines: one CX|artifact line per equipped weapon, armour or helmet artifact;
# an armour adds its helmet shape (CX|artifact_helmet). Artifact knight effectiveness is inside ck3xbl_a_ke.
ck3xbl_emit_cx_artifacts_effect = {
	every_equipped_character_artifact = {
		limit = { OR = { artifact_slot_type = primary_armament artifact_slot_type = armor artifact_slot_type = helmet } }
		if = {
			limit = { rarity = common }
			if = { limit = { artifact_type = helmet } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|helmet|helmet|common" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = helmet_simple } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|helmet|helmet_simple|common" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = armor_mail } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|armor|armor_mail|common" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = armor_plate } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|armor|armor_plate|common" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = armor_scale } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|armor|armor_scale|common" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = armor_lamellar } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|armor|armor_lamellar|common" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = armor_laminar } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|armor|armor_laminar|common" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = armor_brigandine } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|armor|armor_brigandine|common" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = axe } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|axe|common" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = hammer } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|hammer|common" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = mace } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|mace|common" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = spear } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|spear|common" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = sword } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|sword|common" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = dagger } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|dagger|common" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = longbow } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|longbow|common" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = composite } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|composite|common" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = bow } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|bow|common" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = crossbow } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|crossbow|common" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_slot_type = primary_armament } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|unknown|common" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_slot_type = armor } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|armor|unknown|common" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_slot_type = helmet } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|helmet|unknown|common" }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { rarity = masterwork }
			if = { limit = { artifact_type = helmet } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|helmet|helmet|masterwork" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = helmet_simple } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|helmet|helmet_simple|masterwork" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = armor_mail } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|armor|armor_mail|masterwork" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = armor_plate } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|armor|armor_plate|masterwork" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = armor_scale } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|armor|armor_scale|masterwork" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = armor_lamellar } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|armor|armor_lamellar|masterwork" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = armor_laminar } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|armor|armor_laminar|masterwork" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = armor_brigandine } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|armor|armor_brigandine|masterwork" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = axe } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|axe|masterwork" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = hammer } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|hammer|masterwork" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = mace } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|mace|masterwork" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = spear } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|spear|masterwork" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = sword } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|sword|masterwork" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = dagger } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|dagger|masterwork" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = longbow } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|longbow|masterwork" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = composite } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|composite|masterwork" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = bow } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|bow|masterwork" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = crossbow } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|crossbow|masterwork" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_slot_type = primary_armament } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|unknown|masterwork" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_slot_type = armor } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|armor|unknown|masterwork" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_slot_type = helmet } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|helmet|unknown|masterwork" }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { rarity = famed }
			if = { limit = { artifact_type = helmet } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|helmet|helmet|famed" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = helmet_simple } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|helmet|helmet_simple|famed" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = armor_mail } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|armor|armor_mail|famed" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = armor_plate } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|armor|armor_plate|famed" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = armor_scale } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|armor|armor_scale|famed" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = armor_lamellar } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|armor|armor_lamellar|famed" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = armor_laminar } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|armor|armor_laminar|famed" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = armor_brigandine } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|armor|armor_brigandine|famed" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = axe } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|axe|famed" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = hammer } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|hammer|famed" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = mace } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|mace|famed" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = spear } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|spear|famed" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = sword } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|sword|famed" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = dagger } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|dagger|famed" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = longbow } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|longbow|famed" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = composite } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|composite|famed" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = bow } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|bow|famed" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = crossbow } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|crossbow|famed" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_slot_type = primary_armament } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|unknown|famed" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_slot_type = armor } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|armor|unknown|famed" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_slot_type = helmet } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|helmet|unknown|famed" }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { rarity = illustrious }
			if = { limit = { artifact_type = helmet } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|helmet|helmet|illustrious" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = helmet_simple } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|helmet|helmet_simple|illustrious" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = armor_mail } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|armor|armor_mail|illustrious" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = armor_plate } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|armor|armor_plate|illustrious" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = armor_scale } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|armor|armor_scale|illustrious" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = armor_lamellar } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|armor|armor_lamellar|illustrious" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = armor_laminar } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|armor|armor_laminar|illustrious" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = armor_brigandine } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|armor|armor_brigandine|illustrious" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = axe } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|axe|illustrious" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = hammer } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|hammer|illustrious" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = mace } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|mace|illustrious" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = spear } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|spear|illustrious" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = sword } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|sword|illustrious" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = dagger } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|dagger|illustrious" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = longbow } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|longbow|illustrious" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = composite } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|composite|illustrious" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = bow } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|bow|illustrious" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_type = crossbow } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|crossbow|illustrious" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_slot_type = primary_armament } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|primary_armament|unknown|illustrious" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_slot_type = armor } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|armor|unknown|illustrious" }
			else_if = { limit = { artifact_slot_type = helmet } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact|helmet|unknown|illustrious" }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { artifact_slot_type = armor }
			if = { limit = { has_artifact_feature = armor_helmet_spangenhelm } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact_helmet|armor_helmet_spangenhelm" }
			else_if = { limit = { has_artifact_feature = armor_helmet_crested } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact_helmet|armor_helmet_crested" }
			else_if = { limit = { has_artifact_feature = armor_helmet_nasal } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact_helmet|armor_helmet_nasal" }
			else_if = { limit = { has_artifact_feature = armor_helmet_enclosed } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact_helmet|armor_helmet_enclosed" }
			else_if = { limit = { has_artifact_feature = armor_helmet_great_helmet } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact_helmet|armor_helmet_great_helmet" }
			else_if = { limit = { has_artifact_feature = armor_helmet_great_helmet_bascinet } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact_helmet|armor_helmet_great_helmet_bascinet" }
			else_if = { limit = { has_artifact_feature = armor_helmet_great_helmet_cervelliere } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact_helmet|armor_helmet_great_helmet_cervelliere" }
			else_if = { limit = { has_artifact_feature = armor_helmet_turban_helmet } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact_helmet|armor_helmet_turban_helmet" }
			else_if = { limit = { has_artifact_feature = armor_helmet_lamellar } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact_helmet|armor_helmet_lamellar" }
			else_if = { limit = { has_artifact_feature = armor_helmet_cervelliere } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact_helmet|armor_helmet_cervelliere" }
			else_if = { limit = { has_artifact_feature = armor_helmet_kettle } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact_helmet|armor_helmet_kettle" }
			else_if = { limit = { has_artifact_feature = armor_helmet_kulah_khud } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|artifact_helmet|armor_helmet_kulah_khud" }
		}
	}
}
